summary: Klaviyo report queries must send their required JSON:API attributes, campaign revenue must use the campaign values report, and implicit local data must be isolated by account fingerprint under XDG paths.
reason: Empty report POST bodies made campaign, segment, and form reporting fail; campaign metric aggregates returned zero attributed revenue; and one shared default store allowed separate tenants to contaminate local analytics.
validated_outcome: Unit tests cover report request bodies, Shopify conversion-metric resolution, campaign revenue, segment/list targeting joins, supported list fields, stable XDG config discovery, account-scoped database paths, and explicit refusal of ambiguous legacy stores.
